cases.given: Drafts file for launch Apollo, week of 2025-03-10, has validated status red [T-4], amber [T-7], green [T-1, T-2], unvalidated [T-9] and drafts 1 to 4. The launch lead says they sent drafts 1, 2 and 4 and skipped 3 because the owner is on leave.
expect: Launch history gains exactly one new entry with type "week", launch "Apollo", week_of "2025-03-10", and a source of owner or relayed

status matches the drafts file buckets, including unvalidated [T-9], and sent has one item for each of drafts 1, 2 and 4, each with revision 1, its tasks from the drafts index ([] when the file has none), and sent_on null because the launch lead gave no date
skipped is [{draft: 3, reason: owner on leave}] and decided_by and words carry the launch lead's own wording

cases.given: Drafts file has 5 drafts. The launch lead says they sent 1 and 2, edited 2 before sending, and never sent 3, 4 or 5, giving no reason for 5.
expect: sent has items for drafts 1 and 2 only, not all five drafted numbers
skipped has entries for 3, 4 and 5, and the entry for 5 has no invented reason
No entry is written claiming drafts 3 to 5 went out

cases.given: Drafts file for launch Apollo, week of 2025-03-17, ends with a drafts index: draft 1 is T-4 to Sam Whitfield, draft 2 is T-7 to Theo Marsh. The previous week entry sent draft 1 for T-4 to Sam on 2025-03-10. The launch lead says: I sent 1 on Monday 2025-03-17 and 2 sometime this week, not sure when. Sam answered on T-4 on 2025-03-18. Lena Ortiz updated T-9 on 2025-03-19 without being asked.
expect: sent is [{draft: 1, revision: 1, tasks: [T-4], sent_on: 2025-03-17, to: Sam Whitfield}, {draft: 2, revision: 1, tasks: [T-7], sent_on: null, to: Theo Marsh}]
responses has Sam's answer on T-4 on 2025-03-18 answering week 2025-03-17, draft 1, revision 1 (the latest nudge before it), and Lena's update on T-9 on 2025-03-19 with answers null
No responses item is written for Theo Marsh, and no date is filled in for draft 2

cases.given: The step runs when the drafts file exists but the launch lead has not said which items they sent or skipped, and has not been asked yet.
expect: The step asks the launch lead which numbered items they sent, edited or skipped before writing anything

cases.given: Launch history has no entries for this launch. The launch lead has already stated in their message that they sent drafts 1 and 3 and skipped 2 as not needed.
expect: The step does not ask again and records sent items for drafts 1 and 3 and skipped [{draft: 2, reason: not needed}]
A single entry is created with decision null, conditions [] and waivers [], and no gate-decision entry is added

expect: Launch history and the live tracker are unchanged
